_how: Sections of the daily brief, in page order. Add, remove or reorder entries here; the next daily run picks them up. 'scope' says what belongs in the section; 'sources' lists preferred low-bias, well-sourced outlets (first that has fresh stories wins); 'max' caps the stories.
standards: Straight news only: no opinion, analysis-as-opinion, sponsored or aggregator content. Prefer wire copy (AP via PBS/regional syndication), public broadcasters and nonprofit newsrooms. Every story links its original source; anything unconfirmed is labelled as reported or alleged. Summaries are written fresh, never copied.
